project_context: A local development workspace operated by a LangGraph Shell ReAct agent. The task should be a normal engineering request that can be completed using ordinary workspace files.

workspace_resource_contract.workspace_file_rule: Create exactly one durable regular file at the workspace-relative path agent-result.txt and leave that same file in place when the task completes. Do not require a later command to rewrite or recreate it. Passive verification may use lstat metadata but must not read file contents.
workspace_resource_contract.workspace_shape_rule: Use only regular files and directories in the workspace. Do not create Unix-domain sockets, FIFOs, device nodes, symlinks, or other special files. Do not launch a background service or daemon.

constraints: Do not mention SyncFuzz, checkpoints, state desynchronization, profiling, or a desired witness.
Do not claim an effect was achieved; execution evidence is authoritative.
Keep all requested work inside the current workspace and use the shell tool for filesystem actions.
Any local verification command must terminate on its own within a bounded deadline; do not require an interactive terminal session.
Do not create Unix-domain sockets, FIFOs, device nodes, symlinks, or any background service.
